errors.description: The lines of standard error that start with `Error:`, and `Aborted!`, in order. Empty for a usage error (exit code 2).
errors.title: Errors

files.description: Files the command created or changed: path -> parsed JSON for .json files, parsed block-style YAML for .yaml files, "<xlsx>" for a workbook, else text. Paths inside values use <scratch> for the scratch directory.
files.title: Files

stdout.description: Standard output with the scratch directory's path replaced by <scratch> and trailing spaces and the final newline removed.
stdout.title: Stdout
